secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC secret used to sign admin/driver/customer access tokens. A development placeholder is generated automatically; replace it with a strong random value for any shared environment.

secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack secret key for payment authorization and payouts. Optional in development (the held/release ledger runs without it); required for real payments.

secrets.name: PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to verify Paystack webhook signatures. Optional in development.

secrets.name: MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps API key for server-side distance/duration quotes. Optional in development; quotes fail gracefully without it.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI key for the support AI agent. Optional; the deterministic safety policy stays active without it.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for private object storage (pickup evidence, KYC). Production-only; development uses local filesystem storage.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key for private object storage. Production-only.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET
secrets.description: Supabase private storage bucket name. Production-only.
